capture_policy: Licensed Wiley records, raw result JSON/CSV, RIS, screenshots, DOM/page text, source URLs with session/search state, and record-level identifiers may be retained only outside Git under the named restricted root. Tracked artifacts contain only safe aggregate receipts and references.
reason_no_capture: The first required P02 dedicated read-only launcher check reported that http://127.0.0.1:9236 was not live. The stop rule prevented every Wiley request, adapter source invocation, custom-owned page, query, record, export, screenshot, DOM capture, and result artifact.
